name: Eligibility Failure Analysis
query:
select
	r.eligibility_criteria as criteria,
	c.criteria_name,
	c.criteria_code,
	sum(case when r.result = 'Fail' then 1 else 0 end) as fail_count,
	sum(case when r.result = 'Pass' then 1 else 0 end) as pass_count,
	count(*) as evaluations,
	round(sum(case when r.result = 'Fail' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / nullif(count(*), 0), 2) as fail_rate
from `tabClaim Eligibility Result` r
left join `tabClient Eligibility Criteria` c on c.name = r.eligibility_criteria
group by r.eligibility_criteria, c.criteria_name, c.criteria_code
order by fail_count desc
